title: Escape or a click outside closes the list without a change
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep A.
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Sales Representative field.
  2. Press Escape.
  3. Click the field again.
  4. Click on an empty part of the page outside the dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The dropdown opens.

Step 2:

  • The dropdown closes.
  • The field still reads sales rep A.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown opens again.

Step 4:

  • The dropdown closes.
  • The field still reads sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)
